title: FIT File Podcast: Time to Catch Up! So. Many. Watches…Part 1
content:
﻿

In this episode, we dig into the first part of watch season extravaganza/catch-up. From Amazfit to Google to Garmin to COROS to Suunto, the first round begins!

00:00 Intro & Hiatus Catch-Up
02:36 Amazfit Watches
08:33 Google Pixel Watch 5
20:35 Garmin Fenix 9 Series
26:07 Coros Pace 4 Gets Free Maps
29:47 Suunto Run 2

For those not subscribed to the FIT File (it’s free!) via your regular podcast app or on YouTube, here’s a quick post with the highlights from the most recent episode.
